referenceSources.title: One to Buy: ex-Harry Blumer / Edwin Kofel / Edy Brandenberger 1974 Porsche 911 3.0 Carrera RSR — Supercar Nostalgia
referenceSources.description:
This 1974 Porsche 911 3.0 Carrera RSR, chassis 9114609053, is finished in a striking Kelly Green and carries the number 52 on its doors. Period sponsor decals from Goodyear, Cibié, and Sachs accentuate its wide fenders, deep-dish wheels, and prominent rear wing, hallmarks of the Group 4 Renn Sport specification.

Originally campaigned by Swiss privateer Harry Blumer to win the 1974 Schweizer Meisterschaft, the car then passed to Edwin Kofel for the 1975–76 seasons before Edy Brandenberger secured a second Swiss championship in 1977. After a final 1978 season, it was stored for nearly two decades and has since undergone a meticulous restoration. Now offered race-ready at Canepa’s Scotts Valley showroom, this RSR remains a testament to Porsche’s 1970s GT racing dominance.
